CapabilityProfilePort.docs: Resolves the typed dispatch profile for a capability.

CapabilityProviderPort.docs: Dispatches a fully resolved capability through a provider-native adapter.

Reviewer.docs: Performs fast or final review judgments over a complete typed review target.

SchemaExporterPort.docs: Secondary port for domain schema export. This rustdoc/process and filesystem I/O boundary is intentionally blocking and synchronous.

TypeSignalsExecutorPort.docs: Synchronous application-service port for blocking per-layer rustdoc and filesystem evaluation.

TypeSignalsService.docs: Runs validated layer-granular type-signal evaluation through injected ports.

CapabilityDispatchOutcome.docs: Capability-dispatch outcome categories; Executed.u8 is opaque subprocess status (IN-08, OS-05).

CapabilityDispatchRequest.docs: Carries validated command, profile, briefing, and discipline data into a provider adapter.

CapabilityExecError.docs: Reports fail-closed profile, source, preflight, or provider dispatch failures.

CapabilityExecRequest.docs: Validated command requesting a fresh or explicitly resumed capability dispatch.

CapabilityFailureDetail.docs: Opaque sanitized diagnostic returned by capability adapters.

CapabilityFilePath.docs: Validated path to a capability briefing or discipline file.

CapabilityInputValidationError.docs: Reports invalid typed inputs at the capability dispatch boundary.

CapabilityName.docs: Validated capability identifier shared by routing, cache, and dispatch boundaries.

CapabilityProfile.docs: Fully resolved provider, model, effort, and execution mode for one capability dispatch.

CapabilityResumeRequest.docs: Distinguishes fresh dispatch from targetless fallback and target-bound session continuation.

DiagnosticText.docs: Baseline-validated unconstrained diagnostic-text value object reused for opaque usecase failure details; usecase placement preserves its existing co-location with git-workflow consumers.

ModelName.docs: Validated provider model identifier used by dispatch and session compatibility checks.

ProviderName.docs: Validated provider identifier used by routing and session compatibility checks.

ProviderSessionCacheError.docs: Use-case cache failure vocabulary with opaque diagnostic detail.

ReasoningEffort.docs: Closed provider-independent vocabulary for explicitly configured reasoning effort.

ReviewerPrompt.docs: Validated non-empty reviewer prompt used to start or resume reviewer sessions.

TargetArtifactPath.docs: Validated normalized repository-relative artifact path used in capability session identity.

TargetArtifactSet.docs: Non-empty sorted deduplicated target-artifact identity for capability resume.

TimeoutSeconds.docs: Existing non-zero timeout value carried unchanged by CapabilityExecRequest while IN-08 adds fresh-versus-resumed selection to the same `sotp capability exec` command.

TypeSignalsError.docs: Usecase failure contract constructed by TypeSignalsInteractor; opaque failure details reuse the baseline DiagnosticText value object, while track, branch, and layer identities remain validated domain types.

TypeSignalsExecutionError.docs: Opaque adapter diagnostic; String is intentionally unconstrained because it carries no domain concept.

TypeSignalsInteractor.docs: Carries the request's validated TrackId through every layer evaluation and enforces active-track consistency.

TypeSignalsRequest.docs: Typed signal-evaluation command that prevents invalid track, branch, and layer identities from entering the use case.
